description: We are a group of students, who are aiming to solve world problems and getting experience.
summary: Our project helps farmers with their farming advice as we work with satellite pictures as Landsat for measuring land's and plant's health, drought, moisture and etc. Shortly general health of land and plant. it is really important because millions of farmers suffer every year due to lack of products, eventually they can't get enough money so they cant plant much plants next year. And our project solves it greatly. it is associated with field shift challenge. we developed system that gives a short summary via artificial intelligence.
details: it helps farmers to get information summary about their land's and plants' health with NDVI and Landsat satellite pictures. It can solve the food problem in the world. we used python html css javascript an used manus and gemini api for coding. It uses complicated tools for farming which makes it unique. we considered factors like lack of budget, benefit for society.
